exposure: Laparoscopic appendectomy (LA) vs. open appendectomy (OA) during pregnancy
cohort: 48 pregnant women who underwent appendectomy for acute appendicitis
finding: Laparoscopic appendectomy was associated with shorter hospital stay, faster mobilization, and shorter time to first flatus compared to open appendectomy in pregnant women, without significant differences in obstetric or fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in obstetric and fetal outcomes, including delivery mode, between laparoscopic and open appendectomy in pregnant women.
